items.question: What counts as an editor?
items.answer: Anyone who can change content in the Acme dashboard. Git contributors who only open pull requests are free.

items.question: Can I switch plans later?
items.answer: Yes, upgrade or downgrade any time. Changes apply to the next invoice.

items.question: Do you charge for traffic?
items.answer: No. Every plan includes unlimited pages and visitors.
